independentGeometryReport.scope: Independent Python Fraction geometry and scalar L2 reconstruction, using upstream-checked shaping/metrics; no independent font rasterization or Office/WPS layout comparison.

limitations: This low-level entry consumes an explicit line plan. It does not choose line widths, validate UAX14/Office/CJK break legality, enforce mandatory author breaks or synthesize discretionary hyphens.

Metrics use the already verified HarfBuzz 14.5.0 no-synthesis table/variation policy. Strut and natural/exact/atLeast spacing are an explicit draft geometry profile, not an Office/WPS line-height claim.

Internal precision is i128 with 32 fractional EMU bits and ties-away quantization, not arbitrary precision rationals. The independent verifier checks this profile exactly and a cumulative rational error bound; observed 0.5 EMU maximum is corpus-specific, not a universal wire-error guarantee.
Positions and pen ranges are not visual ink bounds. There is no glyph outline extraction, rasterizer, paint, hit testing, alignment, justification, overflow policy or vertical layout here.

Logical bidi controls are retained. Entire X9-only selected fragments have no positions. Mixed-level graphemes, tabs, unresolved fonts and missing metrics explicitly prevent publishing any layout; their final product behavior remains to be implemented.

Whole-font fragment order uses scalar L2 rank while retaining HB glyph sequence. Python reconstructs L2 from returned levels; the upstream shaping and metric references share HarfBuzz. These are not independent target-application layout engines.

Shaping and measurements share verified font resources, but every component batch still uploads bytes and constructs font objects. Persistent font caches, host workers/pools and full cancellation latency budgets remain future work.
Existing scalar, item, line, shaping, fragment and glyph budgets still apply. The 4096-line limit does not imply all documents at that line count fit all budgets.

The new actual fault probe is WASM allocation failure at the first metric call after successful shaping, with no result and permanent module quarantine. It is not exhaustive fault injection or browser/Windows/Linux hosting validation.
Editable advanced presentation objects, playback, Office/WPS acceptance, production hosting and Musterwork replacement gates E0-E3 remain incomplete.
